newsitem.title: UK: LPC - Spain seeks new loan terms.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Spain seeks new loan terms.

text.p: LONDON, August 30 (LPC) - Spain is seeking to refinance a ECU 160 million syndicated bank loan, bankers said.
NatWest Markets is arranging the deal.

The term loan, which matures in November 1999, was originally taken out by Spain's state-owned Instituto Nacional de Industria (INI), in a deal arranged by NatWest in November 1992. The facility has since been assumed by the state.
The renegotiated credit is priced at 6 bps over LIBOR, and is offering upfront fees of 2.5 bps for commitments of ECU 20 million, and 1.5 bps for ECU 10 million.
Repayment is in three instalments starting in November 1997. The 1992 deal was priced 18.75 bps over LIBOR.
